verdict.rationale: Clerk documents OAuth scoped access, M2M tokens, and gating tool calls against permissions/scopes with OAuth brokering for tools (eve), which supports building agent-facing authorization; however, evidence does not show Clerk being positioned as an OAuth authorization server specifically in front of an MCP server per the MCP spec (protected resource metadata, dynamic client registration, token audience binding for MCP), nor any independent confirmation of spec compliance. missing for 10: explicit MCP-server-specific OAuth authorization flow documentation, MCP spec compliance details (resource indicators, dynamic client registration), and independent/hands-on verification of remote agent connection with scoped tokens.
